title: Spinors of Exceptional Super Yang-Mills Theories Are Not Brane Cohomologies
description: LaTeX source and verification code for the paper proving that the Majorana-Weyl spinors of the exceptional super Yang-Mills theories of Rios, Marrani and Chester in (8n+3)+3 and (8n+4)+4 dimensions are not the cohomology of the largest brane: on every spinor the Casimir operator of the brane rotation algebra takes a value that no exterior power attains.
